summary: Full e2e testing of Bored Ideas crowdsourcing app. All 16 backend tests passed. All core UI flows verified working: feed, filters, auth (register/login/logout), idea submission, edit, delete (2-click), voting (toggle), profile page.

issues: TOTAL UPVOTES shows 0 for newly created ideas (correct behavior - seed ideas use author_id='system' not logged-in user, so profile upvotes don't include seeded content)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 66: set_cookie uses secure=False - should be secure=True in production behind HTTPS
server.py line 17: FRONTEND_URL has hardcoded default 'http://localhost:3000' - acceptable for dev but note for prod
format_user() returns both 'id' and '_id' fields - redundant but harmless
server.py is 540 lines - approaching the 700 line threshold but not critical yet
seed_data_creation: Test ideas created and deleted during testing. Two test ideas remain in DB: 'TEST Edit Delete Idea' and 'TEST UI Playwright Idea' (admin authored)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features working. Backend: 16 tests pass. Frontend: Feed, filters (category/time), sort, auth (register/login/logout), idea creation/edit/delete, voting (toggle on/off), profile page all verified. Cookie-based httpOnly JWT auth working correctly. Brute force lockout at 5 failed attempts implemented.
